035/**
036 * Authorization-code grant (RFC 6749 &sect;4.1) flow helper with mandatory PKCE per RFC 7636.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * Wraps Nimbus's {@link AuthorizationRequest} (for URL construction) + {@link AuthorizationCodeGrant} +
040 * {@link TokenRequest} (for the exchange) + {@link CodeChallenge#compute(CodeChallengeMethod, CodeVerifier)
041 * PKCE S256 challenge generation}.  {@link #buildAuthorizationUrl(String, CodeChallenge)} emits a plain OAuth
042 * 2.0 authorization request; {@link #buildAuthenticationUrl(String, CodeChallenge, String, Consumer)} emits an
043 * OpenID Connect authentication request carrying a {@code nonce}.  Supports RFC 8707 resource-indicator binding
044 * via {@link Builder#resource(URI)}.
045 *
046 * <h5 class='topic'>Usage</h5>
047 *
048 * <p class='bjava'>
049 *    <jk>var</jk> flow = OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow.<jsm>create</jsm>()
050 *       .authorizationEndpoint(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/oauth2/authorize"</js>))
051 *       .tokenEndpoint(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/oauth2/token"</js>))
052 *       .clientId(<js>"web-app"</js>)
053 *       .redirectUri(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://app.example.com/callback"</js>))
054 *       .scope(<js>"openid"</js>, <js>"profile"</js>)
055 *       .build();
056 *
057 *    <jk>var</jk> verifier = <jk>new</jk> CodeVerifier();
058 *    <jk>var</jk> challenge = CodeChallenge.<jsm>compute</jsm>(CodeChallengeMethod.<jsf>S256</jsf>, verifier);
059 *    <jk>var</jk> authUrl = flow.buildAuthorizationUrl(<js>"some-state"</js>, challenge);
060 *
061 *    <jc>// After the IdP redirects back with ?code=...</jc>
062 *    <jk>var</jk> token = flow.exchange(<jv>code</jv>, verifier);
063 * </p>
064 *
065 * <p>
066 * The flow does NOT manage state / PKCE-verifier storage; that's the caller's responsibility.
067 *
068 * @since 10.0.0
069 */
070@SuppressWarnings({
071   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are OAuth protocol parameter names (e.g. "code", "grant_type"); intentional
072})
073public class OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow {
074
075   /**
076    * Static creator.
077    *
078    * @return A new builder.
079    */
080   public static Builder create() {
081      return new Builder();
082   }
083
084   /**
085    * Builder.
086    */
087   public static class Builder {
088      private URI authorizationEndpoint;
089      private URI tokenEndpoint;
090      private String clientId;
091      private Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
092      private URI redirectUri;
093      private Set<String> scopes = st();
094      private URI resource;
095      private Duration httpTimeout = Flows.DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT;
096      private Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
097
098      /** Constructor. */
099      protected Builder() {}
100
101      /**
102       * Sets the authorization endpoint URL.  Required.
103       *
104       * @param value The endpoint URL.
105       * @return This object.
106       */
107      public Builder authorizationEndpoint(URI value) {
108         authorizationEndpoint = assertSecureOrLoopback(assertArgNotNull("value", value));
109         return this;
110      }
111
112      /**
113       * Sets the token endpoint URL.  Required.
114       *
115       * @param value The endpoint URL.
116       * @return This object.
117       */
118      public Builder tokenEndpoint(URI value) {
119         tokenEndpoint = assertSecureOrLoopback(assertArgNotNull("value", value));
120         return this;
121      }
122
123      /**
124       * Sets the OAuth client ID.  Required.
125       *
126       * @param value The client ID.
127       * @return This object.
128       */
129      public Builder clientId(String value) {
130         clientId = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
131         return this;
132      }
133
134      /**
135       * Sets the client secret.  May be omitted for public clients (PKCE-only).
136       *
137       * @param value The client secret.
138       * @return This object.
139       */
140      public Builder clientSecret(String value) {
141         assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
142         clientSecretSupplier = () -> value;
143         return this;
144      }
145
146      /**
147       * Sets the client secret via a supplier.
148       *
149       * @param value The supplier.
150       * @return This object.
151       */
152      public Builder clientSecretSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
153         clientSecretSupplier = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
154         return this;
155      }
156
157      /**
158       * Sets the redirect URI.  Required.
159       *
160       * @param value The redirect URI.
161       * @return This object.
162       */
163      public Builder redirectUri(URI value) {
164         redirectUri = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
165         return this;
166      }
167
168      /**
169       * Adds requested scopes.
170       *
171       * @param values The scopes.
172       * @return This object.
173       */
174      public Builder scope(String... values) {
175         assertArgNotNull("values", values);
176         for (var v : values) {
177            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("scope", v);
178            scopes.add(v);
179         }
180         return this;
181      }
182
183      /**
184       * Sets the RFC 8707 {@code resource} indicator sent on both the authorization request and the token exchange.
185       *
186       * @param value The canonical resource URI.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
187       * @return This object.
188       */
189      public Builder resource(URI value) {
190         resource = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
191         return this;
192      }
193
194      /**
195       * Sets the connect/read timeout applied to the token-exchange request.  Default 10 seconds.
196       *
197       * @param value The timeout.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be positive.
198       * @return This object.
199       */
200      public Builder httpTimeout(Duration value) {
201         assertArgNotNull("value", value);
202         assertArg(!value.isZero() && !value.isNegative(), "httpTimeout must be positive (was %s)", value);
203         httpTimeout = value;
204         return this;
205      }
206
207      /**
208       * Sets the HTTP request configurator (applied to the token-exchange request).
209       *
210       * @param value The callback.
211       * @return This object.
212       */
213      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
214         httpRequestConfigurator = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
215         return this;
216      }
217
218      /**
219       * Builds the flow.
220       *
221       * @return A new {@link OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow}.
222       */
223      public OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow build() {
224         if (authorizationEndpoint == null)
225            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow requires authorizationEndpoint(...)");
226         if (tokenEndpoint == null)
227            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow requires tokenEndpoint(...)");
228         if (clientId == null)
229            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow requires clientId(...)");
230         if (redirectUri == null)
231            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow requires redirectUri(...)");
232         return new OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow(this);
233      }
234   }
235
236   private final URI authorizationEndpoint;
237   private final URI tokenEndpoint;
238   private final String clientId;
239   private final Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
240   private final URI redirectUri;
241   private final Set<String> scopes;
242   private final URI resource;
243   private final Duration httpTimeout;
244   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
245
246   /**
247    * Constructor.
248    *
249    * @param b The builder.
250    */
251   protected OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow(Builder b) {
252      this.authorizationEndpoint = b.authorizationEndpoint;
253      this.tokenEndpoint = b.tokenEndpoint;
254      this.clientId = b.clientId;
255      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
256      this.redirectUri = b.redirectUri;
257      this.scopes = u(cp(b.scopes));
258      this.resource = b.resource;
259      this.httpTimeout = b.httpTimeout;
260      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
261   }
262
263   /**
264    * Builds the {@code authorize?...} URL the user-agent should be redirected to.
265    *
266    * @param state The opaque {@code state} parameter (CSRF protection).  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or
267    *    blank.
268    * @param codeChallenge The PKCE code challenge.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.  Always uses S256.
269    * @return The authorization URL.
270    */
271   @SuppressWarnings({
272      "deprecation" // Nimbus CodeChallenge overload is deprecated; no simpler alternative yet.
273   })
274   public URI buildAuthorizationUrl(String state, CodeChallenge codeChallenge) {
275      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("state", state);
276      assertArgNotNull("codeChallenge", codeChallenge);
277      Scope nimbusScope = scopes.isEmpty() ? null : new Scope(scopes.toArray(new String[0]));
278      var requestBuilder = new AuthorizationRequest.Builder(new ResponseType(ResponseType.Value.CODE), new ClientID(clientId))
279         .endpointURI(authorizationEndpoint)
280         .redirectionURI(redirectUri)
281         .scope(nimbusScope)
282         .state(new State(state))
283         .codeChallenge(codeChallenge, CodeChallengeMethod.S256);
284      if (resource != null)
285         requestBuilder.resource(resource);
286      return requestBuilder.build().toURI();
287   }
288
289   /**
290    * Builds an OpenID Connect {@code authorize?...} URL carrying an OIDC {@code nonce} parameter.
291    *
292    * <p>
293    * Unlike {@link #buildAuthorizationUrl(String, CodeChallenge)} (which emits a plain OAuth 2.0
294    * {@link AuthorizationRequest} with no {@code nonce}), this method emits an OIDC
295    * {@link AuthenticationRequest} so the IdP echoes the supplied {@code nonce} back inside the issued
296    * ID token.  An OpenID Connect relying party stores the {@code nonce} before the redirect and
297    * verifies the {@code nonce} claim on the returned ID token to defeat token replay.
298    *
299    * <p>
300    * The configured {@code scope(...)} set is used as-is; OIDC requires it to contain {@code openid}.
301    * The optional {@code customizer} receives the underlying {@link com.nimbusds.openid.connect.sdk.AuthenticationRequest.Builder} so
302    * callers can set OIDC-specific parameters (e.g. {@code prompt}, {@code max_age}, {@code acr_values})
303    * without this module needing to surface each one.
304    *
305    * @param state The opaque {@code state} parameter (CSRF protection).  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or
306    *    blank.
307    * @param codeChallenge The PKCE code challenge.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.  Always uses S256.
308    * @param nonce The OIDC {@code nonce} value.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
309    * @param customizer Optional hook on the {@link com.nimbusds.openid.connect.sdk.AuthenticationRequest.Builder} for OIDC-specific
310    *    parameters.  May be <jk>null</jk>.
311    * @return The authorization URL.
312    */
313   @SuppressWarnings({
314      "deprecation" // Nimbus CodeChallenge overload is deprecated; no simpler alternative yet.
315   })
316   public URI buildAuthenticationUrl(String state, CodeChallenge codeChallenge, String nonce, Consumer<AuthenticationRequest.Builder> customizer) {
317      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("state", state);
318      assertArgNotNull("codeChallenge", codeChallenge);
319      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("nonce", nonce);
320      Scope nimbusScope = scopes.isEmpty() ? new Scope("openid") : new Scope(scopes.toArray(new String[0]));
321      var builder = new AuthenticationRequest.Builder(new ResponseType(ResponseType.Value.CODE), nimbusScope, new ClientID(clientId), redirectUri)
322         .endpointURI(authorizationEndpoint)
323         .state(new State(state))
324         .nonce(new Nonce(nonce))
325         .codeChallenge(codeChallenge, CodeChallengeMethod.S256);
326      if (customizer != null)
327         customizer.accept(builder);
328      return builder.build().toURI();
329   }
330
331   /**
332    * Exchanges the authorization code returned by the IdP for an access token.
333    *
334    * @param code The {@code code} query parameter from the IdP redirect.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or
335    *    blank.
336    * @param codeVerifier The PKCE verifier matching the challenge passed to
337    *    {@link #buildAuthorizationUrl(String, CodeChallenge)}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
338    * @return The acquired token.
339    */
340   public OAuthToken exchange(String code, CodeVerifier codeVerifier) {
341      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("code", code);
342      assertArgNotNull("codeVerifier", codeVerifier);
343      var grant = new AuthorizationCodeGrant(new AuthorizationCode(code), redirectUri, codeVerifier);
344      TokenRequest.Builder reqBuilder;
345      if (clientSecretSupplier != null) {
346         var clientAuth = new ClientSecretBasic(new ClientID(clientId), new Secret(clientSecretSupplier.get()));
347         reqBuilder = new TokenRequest.Builder(tokenEndpoint, clientAuth, grant);
348      } else {
349         reqBuilder = new TokenRequest.Builder(tokenEndpoint, new ClientID(clientId), grant);
350      }
351      if (resource != null)
352         reqBuilder.resource(resource);
353      return Flows.send(reqBuilder.build(), httpTimeout, httpRequestConfigurator);
354   }
